scientific_integrity: All norms and constants are stated with explicit normalizations. The asymptotic coefficient is a convergent one-dimensional matrix integral for the stated p range. Independently unchecked historical priority is not a certification.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean circular annuli; angularly normalized boundary L2; weight (1-r^2)^alpha on outer boundary only. The finite numerical checks do not establish the infinite theorem; that follows from the analytic fiber argument. General pseudodifferential theory can yield qualitative spectral-order analogues; priority remains provisional.
title: Two-boundary Schatten splitting and a universal thin-annulus Poisson spectrum
